summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance on node1. The settings survived a verified node reboot, and external network connectivity recovered successfully.
actions_performed: Created /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf with accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0 for all and default IPv4 scopes.
Applied the settings immediately and cleared them on existing interfaces.
Safely rebooted node1 once and verified its boot ID changed from a9593011-3617-4b72-8b02-2e8a4d2b17a3 to e8ae0bae-00ec-40f6-8295-4f22b38e70b5.
Verified the persistent configuration, live all/default/ens2 values, IPv4 address, default route, and gateway reachability after restart.

evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
evidence.summary: Shows successful configuration application, zero live values, persistent file entries, and post-restart survival.
Shows the healthy pre-restart state, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered hardened networking with functional address, route, and gateway connectivity.
